heading: 14.8 Display and interpolation
text:
### 14.8 Display and interpolation [LUNI.14.8]

Display convention (`i` vs `j`) is a context property, not stored in the value.

**The convention is `i`, and it is set per interpolation site or not at all.**
A site that wants `j` says so at the site.

#### Per-interpolation override

`i` and `j` join the format types ([LGRA.2.9.6.1]) when the type is built:

- **`i`** — force imaginary unit display as `i` at this site
- **`j`** — force imaginary unit display as `j` at this site

Negative imaginary displays as subtraction: `"3.0 - 2.0i ohm"` not
`"3.0 + -2.0i ohm"`.
